purpose: Offline local input documentation, not a sale configuration or accepted release evidence

catalogue.requirements: Positive globally unique integer IDs and model names; exact selected metadata/attributes/functions/cover; positive safe integer sunflower price. No fallback/internal rows or invented identities. Input hash is recorded, not certified as a live observation.

products.format: Exactly three gardenPackOfferSchema objects from existing service contract
products.requirements: Exact derived recipes/current individual allocations and reviewed evidence; existing full immutable version digest; publication/window changes mint new versions; emitted sale.enabled is always false. Never installed by the tool.

evidence.format: Object with exactly schemaVersion:1, sourceFingerprint:<actual report hash>, artifacts:<array>
evidence.requirements: Unique safe repository-relative regular-file paths; actual SHA256; current selected source fingerprint. Unknown fields, booleans or stale fingerprints fail. Artifact assertions are never automatically accepted as a release gate.

output.gitProvenance: headCommit/headTree/workingTreeStatus describe local Git separately; sourceFingerprint describes inspected bytes. Dirty trees cannot be relabelled as the HEAD source. Archives may use null Git provenance.
